set.body: Owner: ScalaFIM design/formula. EventModelBuilder currently infers numeric columns as continuous and text as categorical; model editors need explicit roles for numeric condition codes and validation of source amplitudes. Add categorical(column) and continuous(column) native formula expressions with one-argument checks, existing declared factor-level binding, stable original source/column identities, raw unscaled amplitudes and typed errors. Preserve existing implicit expressions. Verify ordinary EventDesignRequest/ModelBuildSpec callers, numeric condition contrasts and amplitude/convolution values, declared level order, malformed/nonfinite/missing values and both JVM/JS suites. PLS Neuro W3 bd-01M1YVQ44TVRBAY11F30K7BTA1 owns consumer controls/adoption, not native scientific code.
set.title: Make event column roles explicit in native formulas
